description:
intent=i048 snapshot=s12 branch=unclamped-wire-count status=complete
finding location=drivers/scsi/pmcraid.c:5027-5033 confidence=medium conclusion=PMC MaxRAID adapter-written config table num_entries (le16) is iterated in pmcraid_init_res_table with no clamp against the 256-entry entries[] arrays, so firmware reporting >256 drives OOB reads of cfgte and 40-byte OOB memcpy into kernel resource entries.
unresolved location=drivers/usb/usbip/usbip_common.c:473 conclusion=Seed location confirmed unpatched in s12 and excluded by rule; follow up only to confirm it is tracked as the demonstration instance.
unresolved location=drivers/scsi/esas2r/esas2r_main.c:1443 conclusion=Follow up: read the num_targets_backend consumer loop and check it against the array it indexes (candidate for the same asymmetric-clamp pattern as pmcraid).
unresolved location=drivers/scsi/qla4xxx/ql4_nx.c:2640 conclusion=Follow up: verify the minidump entry-processing path cannot make the unbounded count loop corrupt state past entry-buffer accounting (MMIO-only loop, likely DoS-grade, not memory R/W).
coverage_gap=On-disk metadata count stores grep-enumerated but not read line-by-line (bcachefs sb-downgrade nr_errors, UDF numOfPartitions/numPartitionMaps, exfat clu_count, hfs/hfsplus num_recs/node_count, dm-era nr_bits, dm-zoned nr_chunks); a corrupt-fs threat model was not established for any of them.
coverage_gap=Bluetooth hci_event/hci_mgmt event count fields, 802.15.4/6LoWPAN frame parsers, and AF_ALG/crypto user-socket length paths were not swept in this pass.
coverage_gap=NFS/AFS/Ceph XDR reply decoders were spot-checked at known count sites (yfsclient ACL sizes, nfs42 xattr/list counts, blocklayout and filelayout counts, ceph split counts) and found bounded, but the remainder of nfs4xdr.c/nfs42xdr.c decode functions were not read line-by-line.
coverage_gap=The smartpqi firmware_features->num_elements family (smartpqi_init.c:7788-7868) and iwlwifi n_channels/mcc reply fields were only grep-inspected with visible bounds at the store sites; full consumer loops were not read.
